Hello Amina,

Thank you for contacting NovaTech. We have received your request to cancel the 2TB Cloud Storage subscription renewal for order ORD-4490.

In accordance with our Billing & Subscription Policy (POL-BIL-005), annual subscriptions cancelled after the initial 48-hour window are eligible for a prorated refund of the unused term minus standard processing ($15.00). We have calculated your net prorated refund at $184.00, submitted for billing management sign-off.

Best regards,
NovaTech Billing Services
